title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
summary: 构建增强感知3D MedNeXt分割框架，以测量保真度为主要终点开展多队列与外部验证。
key_points: 内部测试与DUKE共521例配对病例
肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%，ICC 0.97
外部源留出分层Dice中位0.823
reason: 多队列外部验证并以测量保真度为主要终点，属重要档
abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.
zh_abstract: 自动乳腺动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）分割可促进肿瘤定量测量，但仅几何重叠并不能确立掩膜衍生测量的保真度。我们开发了一个增强感知的三维 MedNeXt 框架，具有门控跳跃融合和边界监督，并在回顾性多队列设计中对其进行评估，涵盖锁定内部测试、源数据留出评估、回顾性外部验证和放射科医师审查。测量保真度是主要终点。在521例配对的内部测试和DUKE病例中，中位误差为肿瘤体积9.7%、三维最大表面直径1.8 mm、操作性增强定义体积10.2%，相应ICC分别为0.97、0.80和0.97。中位Dice在内部为0.831，在DUKE源数据留出层为0.823；在使用冻结检查点且未进行外部标签调优的情况下，在BC-MRI-SEG和公开BreastDCEDL_AMBL回顾性外部验证队列中分别为0.812和0.806。在盲法双读者审查中，80个掩膜中有78个无需重大修正。在276例配对反应分析病例中，自动几何的AUROC为0.732，专家几何为0.757（差异，−0.025；95% CI，−0.095至0.045）；未证明判别非劣效性。这些发现支持自动分割作为在所评估队列内由放射科医师监督的回顾性定量研究的起点，同时区分测量保真度与下游预测等效性。

title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
zh_title: 学习型健康系统框架与AI整合：范围综述
summary: 梳理美国54项学习型健康系统框架研究与30项AI/数据科学研究，考察AI如何嵌入此类持续学习体系。
key_points: 纳入54项框架研究，其中44%为概念性改造
另纳入30项AI与数据科学研究
归纳数据基础设施、治理等五大组件
reason: 范围综述，系统检索与双人筛选规范，但无外部验证与结局数据，属综述上限档
abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
zh_abstract: 学习型卫生系统（Learning Health Systems, LHSs）利用常规收集的数据生成证据，通过持续学习循环为实践提供信息。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但LHS框架与AI应用如何关联仍不清楚。我们梳理了LHS框架及其组成部分，并考察AI和数据科学如何被整合。检索识别出2007年1月至2025年8月发表的、基于美国的英语研究；两名评审员独立筛选和提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入54项框架研究（24项[44%]为概念性改编；30项[56%]为真实世界实施）和30项AI/数据科学研究。框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化、公平与伦理。相对于框架研究，AI研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% vs 35%）或公平（13% vs 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数AI研究（27/30）集中于数据到知识阶段；仅3项延伸到知识到实践，且无一项描述实践到数据的反馈，即利用部署后结局为模型更新提供信息。AI应用仅捕捉了LHS愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，对将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织和反馈机制关注较少。

title: EvoXRare AI-Assisted Interpretation of Emergency Chest Radiographs
zh_title: EvoXRare辅助急诊胸片判读的随机试验
summary: 新注册的实用型随机试验，计划纳入7万例，评估AI胸片报告草稿与高危提示能否减少重要病变漏诊。
key_points: 注册信息显示尚未开始招募，暂无结果
计划入组70000例急诊与重症患者
对照常规判读，主要终点为重要病变漏诊
reason: 大规模实用型随机设计并报告临床结局，但仅注册、无结果，前瞻加分后仍停在值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Emergency and Critical Care, Chest Radiography, Diagnostic Error, Thoracic Abnormalities; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE1; enrollment: 70000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Chest radiography is widely used in emergency departments, resuscitation rooms, intensive care units, and other acute-care settings. Clinically important abnormalities may be missed because findings are subtle, uncommon, obscured by overlapping anatomy, or encountered under high workload. This pragmatic randomized trial evaluates whether EvoXRare, an artificial intelligence system that provides a draft chest radiograph report and high-risk alerts for uncommon or clinically important abnormalities, reduces clinically important diagnostic misses compared with routine physician interpretation alone. Approximately 70,000 adults will be randomized 1:1 across 15-20 hospitals in China. The primary endpoint is the patient-level rate of clinically important abnormalities present on the reference standard but not reported in the initial clinical interpretation. Key secondary outcomes include detection of rare or easily missed findings, time to recognition of critical abnormalities, report turnaround time, false-positive alerts, additional imaging, recall/communication events, and selected short-term clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院（Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology）；疾病/状况：急诊与重症监护、胸部X线摄影、诊断错误、胸部异常；类型：干预性；分期：PHASE1（1期）；入组人数：70000；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 胸部X线摄影广泛用于急诊科、复苏室、重症监护病房及其他急性护理环境。由于表现细微、少见、被重叠解剖结构遮挡或在高工作负荷下遇到，临床重要异常可能被遗漏。这项实用性随机试验评估EvoXRare——一种提供胸部X线摄影报告草稿并针对少见或临床重要异常发出高风险警报的人工智能系统——与仅由医生进行常规判读相比，是否减少临床重要诊断遗漏。约70,000名成人将在中国15-20家医院按1:1随机分组。主要终点是参考标准中存在但初始临床判读中未报告的临床重要异常的患者水平发生率。关键次要结局包括少见或易漏诊表现的检出、关键异常识别时间、报告周转时间、假阳性警报、额外影像检查、召回/沟通事件以及选定的短期临床结局。

title: Do Large Language Models Show Racial and Sex Bias in Pain Management? A Counterfactual Audit of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen
zh_title: 大模型疼痛管理中的种族与性别偏倚审计
summary: 对17个模型24种配置做反事实审计，检验疼痛管理建议中的种族与性别偏倚。
key_points: 多模型评估六种急性疼痛情境
身份明示或用姓名线索对比白人男性参照
探索性非预注册分析，预印本未经评审
reason: 多模型偏倚审计有新意，但探索性非预注册预印本，证据有限
abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.
zh_abstract: 种族和族裔少数群体患者接受的疼痛治疗少于非西班牙裔白人患者，而用作医学AI的大语言模型（LLMs）可能重现这种偏倚。此前的审计测试了少数专有模型，明确说明种族，且很少测量模型自身的回答不稳定性。在探索性、非预先注册的分析中，研究1让四个开放权重LLMs评估六个急性疼痛情景案例，覆盖四个种族和两个性别的每一种组合，身份被明确说明或仅通过姓名提示（每组两个姓名），将每个身份与同一病例和采样种子上的白人男性参照进行比较。在研究2中，17个模型的24种配置，包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-4.1 mini 和 gpt-oss、Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku 4.5、Google 的 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Meta 的 Llama、DeepSeek 和 Qwen，在推理开启和关闭以及两种精度下，回答了相同的情景案例和50个临床医生编写的 Q-Pain 病例。在这个单一提示、JSON约束任务中，研究1中没有差异在校正后仍然存在，研究2的1,386项比较中没有任何一项在错误发现率校正后仍然存在，并且每一个疼痛严重程度差异在0-10量表的一个点以内均等效于零（238项Q-Pain比较中有237项在四分之一点以内）。阿片类药物决策的界限较不精确（研究1无法排除约20个百分点的差异），因此它们显示未检测到差异，而非证明不存在差异。模型内经过校正后仍存在的少数差异偏向黑人患者。模型之间以及模型自身不同设置之间的差异远大于患者之间的差异（参考患者在6%至93%的回答中接受了高剂量阿片类药物），尽管服务软件、提供商和提示格式也有所不同。临床AI的公平性审计应每组使用多个姓名、在种子上配对比较、报告噪声底限，并测试每个部署配置。

title: Neonatal AI-Based Early Warning System for Late-Onset Sepsis and Necrotizing Enterocolitis in the NICU: Assessment of Response and Effectiveness
zh_title: 新生儿NICU脓毒症与NEC的AI早期预警试验
summary: 新注册500例前瞻性干预试验，评估Intellicens Neo预警早产儿脓毒症与NEC。
key_points: 尚未招募，暂无任何结果数据
纳入胎龄小于32周的NICU早产儿
基于心率等常规数据识别风险模式
reason: 前瞻性干预设计有价值，但仅注册信息且无结果，介于值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University Hospital, Antwerp; conditions: Late Onset Neonatal Sepsis, Necrotizing Enterocolitis of Newborn; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 500; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate the Intellicens software, an artificial intelligence (AI)-based early warning system designed to help doctors and nurses detect serious complications in premature babies at an early stage. These complications include bloodstream infections (sepsis) and necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), a serious condition affecting the intestines. The study will involve babies born before 32 weeks of pregnancy who are admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). The Intellicens Neo model analyses routinely collected medical data, such as heart rate, to identify patterns that may indicate an increased risk of sepsis or NEC and generate an early warning for healthcare professionals. The treating doctor remains responsible for deciding whether further examinations or treatment are needed. The software has previously been tested using data from babies who had already been discharged from hospital, with promising results. This study will evaluate how well the software performs in real-life clinical practice during the hospital stay.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：安特卫普大学医院；疾病：晚发型新生儿脓毒症、新生儿坏死性小肠结肠炎；类型：干预性；阶段：NA；入组人数：500；状态：尚未招募] 本研究旨在评估 Intellicens 软件，这是一种基于人工智能（AI）的早期预警系统，旨在帮助医生和护士早期发现早产儿的严重并发症。这些并发症包括血流感染（脓毒症）和坏死性小肠结肠炎（NEC），后者是一种影响肠道的严重疾病。本研究将纳入妊娠32周前出生并入住新生儿重症监护病房（NICU）的婴儿。Intellicens Neo 模型分析常规收集的医疗数据（如心率），以识别可能提示脓毒症或NEC风险增加的模式，并向医疗专业人员生成早期预警。主治医生仍负责决定是否需要进一步检查或治疗。该软件此前已使用已出院婴儿的数据进行测试，结果令人鼓舞。本研究将评估该软件在住院期间真实临床实践中的表现。

title: The role of artificial intelligence in urological malignancies: an overview of systematic reviews.
source: PubMed · The Canadian journal of urology
zh_title: AI在泌尿系统肿瘤中的应用：系统综述总览
summary: 汇总多篇系统综述，评估AI模型在泌尿肿瘤诊断、预后与治疗路径中的性能与临床效用。
key_points: 检索1974至2024年主要数据库的系统综述
结局指标含AUC-ROC、敏感度、特异度
遵循Cochrane系统综述总览方法
reason: 系统综述总览属二次证据汇总，摘要未给出具体效能数据，属综述档
abstract: [The Canadian journal of urology] Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform clinical medicine by enhancing diagnostic precision, prognostic accuracy, and personalized decision making. In urological oncology, AI technologies are increasingly integrated across diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic pathways. This overview of systematic reviews aims to synthesise the current evidence on the performance and clinical utility of AI applications in urological malignancies. A systematic search was conducted of major bibliographic databases from 1974 to October 2024 to identify systematic reviews (SRs) evaluating AI-based models in urological cancers. We followed the Cochrane methodology of Overviews of Reviews. Outcomes of interest included diagnostic accuracy metrics (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC-ROC], sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy) and predictive performance for treatment-relatedoutcomes. A total of 67 SRs encompassing 1139 primary studies were included. RoB was assessed as low in 21 reviews, high in 41, and unclear in 5. Forty-five SRs evaluated AI in prostate cancer (PCa). AI models demonstrated high accuracy (88-93%) in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions, and outperformed human interpretation alone in predicting clinically significant PCa (AUC: 0.933 vs. AUC: 0.82-0.87). Performance in Gleason score classification was also very strong (AUC: 0.72-0.99, Accuracy: 70.8-93.0%). Sixteen SRs assessed AI in Renal carcinoma (RCa), reporting accurate subtype classification and tumor grade prediction, with some models exceeding 90% accuracy. Sixteen SRs focused on Bladder Cancer (BCa), showing improved detection of muscle-invasive disease and recurrence risk prediction compared with the conventional approach. Key limitations included heterogeneity in validation strategies, overlap of primary studies across reviews, and potential oversampling due to synthetic or augmented data. AI-based models consistently demonstrate improved diagnostic and predictive performance across urological malignancies and hold promise for enhancing clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. At present, AI tools should be regarded as decision-support systems that complement, rather than replace, clinical expertise. Future research should emphasize prospective validation, standardized outcome definitions, and evaluation of real-world clinical impact. Robust and harmonized evaluation frameworks are also essential to address challenges related to data quality
zh_abstract: [《The Canadian Journal of Urology》] 人工智能（AI）有潜力通过提高诊断精确性、预后准确性和个性化决策来变革临床医学。在泌尿肿瘤学中，AI技术正日益整合到诊断、预后和治疗路径中。本系统综述的概述旨在综合当前关于AI应用在泌尿系统恶性肿瘤中的性能和临床效用的证据。我们对主要书目数据库进行了系统检索，时间范围为1974年至2024年10月，以识别评估泌尿系统癌症中AI模型的系统综述（SRs）。我们遵循Cochrane Reviews概述方法学。关注结局包括诊断准确性指标（受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUC-ROC]、灵敏度、特异度和准确率）以及治疗相关结局的预测性能。共纳入67篇SRs，涵盖1139项原始研究。21篇综述的偏倚风险（RoB）评估为低，41篇为高，5篇不明确。45篇SRs评估了AI在前列腺癌（PCa）中的应用。AI模型在区分良性与恶性病变方面表现出高准确率（88-93%），并在预测临床显著PCa方面优于单独人类判读（AUC：0.933 vs AUC：0.82-0.87）。Gleason评分分类性能也非常强（AUC：0.72-0.99，准确率：70.8-93.0%）。16篇SRs评估了AI在肾癌（RCa）中的应用，报告了准确的亚型分类和肿瘤分级预测，部分模型准确率超过90%。16篇SRs聚焦于膀胱癌（BCa），显示与常规方法相比，在肌层浸润性疾病检测和复发风险预测方面有所改善。关键局限性包括验证策略的异质性、综述间原始研究重叠，以及由于合成或增强数据导致的潜在过采样。基于AI的模型在泌尿系统恶性肿瘤中一致表现出改善的诊断和预测性能，并有望增强临床决策和患者结局。目前，AI工具应被视为决策支持系统，补充而非替代临床专业知识。未来研究应强调前瞻性验证、标准化结局定义和真实世界临床影响评估。稳健且协调一致的评估框架对于应对数据质量相关挑战也至关重要。

title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
zh_title: BenchmarkHub：医疗大模型可复现评测开源平台
summary: 开源平台 BenchmarkHub 用于生物医学语言与视觉语言模型的可审计评测，完整记录提示、推理设置与评分规则。

abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). Re-grading the responses with simple answer-extraction rules lowered a model's accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points, leading to a reorder of the leaderboard. Published scores were found for 23 out of the 143 benchmark/model combinations tested. The accuracy measured by BenchmarkHub was lower than in the published results in 19 out of the 23 available comparisons. The effect of four prompting protocols (1: default prompt; 2: asking the model to answer the letter only; 3: chain-of-thought prompting; 4: three-shot prompting) changed MedQA accuracy by up to 11.3 points but was not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions. We also tested the impact of ablation on benchmarking using the MMMU benchmark dataset. Removing images lowered the accuracy by 18.0 and 19.3 points respectively for the two strongest models. Finally, the accuracy of agentic benchmarks using a sandboxed interpreter increased on computational biology tasks by 36-63 points. Interpretation: Benchmarking is essential to assess the impact and validity of LLMs for medical applications. BenchmarkHub allows a fair and rigorous comparison of models across esta
zh_abstract: 【背景】大语言模型（LLMs）仅根据其在生物医学基准上的得分来评判，但由于提示、推理设置和模型构建版本很少报告，这些得分很少可复现。我们开发了 BenchmarkHub，一个用于生物医学研究中语言模型和视觉-语言模型可审计评估的开源平台。【方法】BenchmarkHub 是一个 Python Web 应用（Django 5.2，SQLite），根据 MIT 许可证发布，可在 https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub 获取。该应用可通过浏览器界面、一组命令行工具和 REST API 访问，因此交互式探索和脚本化流水线会产生相同、可比较的记录。该平台使用固定种子采样问题，直接运行模型或在代码沙箱中作为使用工具的代理运行模型，使用确定性规则对答案评分，并存储每个提示、回复和工具调用。该界面提供排行榜对模型性能进行排名，使无需任何既有编程知识即可比较模型。【结果】我们使用 BenchmarkHub 在五项实验中评估了12个开放权重模型，涵盖15个生物医学基准（11个文本、两个多模态和两个计算生物学）和两个通用基准。合并准确率范围为46.1%（95% CI 43.0-49.3）至80.9%（78.3-83.3）。使用简单的答案提取规则重新评分回答，使某模型的准确率最多降低33.1个百分点，导致排行榜重新排序。在测试的143个基准/模型组合中，找到了23个已发表得分。在23项可用比较中，有19项 BenchmarkHub 测得的准确率低于已发表结果。四种提示方案（1：默认提示；2：要求模型仅回答字母；3：思维链提示；4：三样本提示）的影响使 MedQA 准确率最多变化11.3点，但在150个问题的多重检验校正后不显著。我们还使用 MMMU 基准数据集测试了消融对基准测试的影响。移除图像使两个最强模型的准确率分别降低18.0和19.3点。最后，使用沙箱化解释器的代理式基准在计算生物学任务上的准确率提高了36-63点。【解释】基准测试对于评估 LLMs 在医学应用中的影响和有效性至关重要。BenchmarkHub 允许跨 esta 对模型进行公平而严格的比较

abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（Large Vision-Language Models, LVLM）的最新进展增强了X线报告生成，但常常忽视临床背景、忽略工作流程整合，并缺乏可解释性，这由于可解释性和可靠性问题而阻碍临床采用。本文针对临床AI应用中自动X线报告生成的双重挑战：性能与专家可解释性。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及基于Transformer的文本编码器，该编码器整合患者病史以生成放射学报告。进一步，我们探索一种专家引导的“由内而外”（inside-out）方法，并仅提取异常表现用于放射学报告优化。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器和LLMs，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践所需可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的IU X-Ray数据集上进一步评估，以展示其泛化性和稳健性。我们采用GREEN指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在MIMIC-CXR上获得0.327分，在IU X-Ray上获得0.605分，均高于MAIRA-2在相同评估设置下取得的分数。它在标准评估指标上也具有竞争力，经常匹配或超过最先进模型。此外，我们引入了从放射科医生视角开发的定性评估指标，并对100份生成报告进行初步放射科医生评估，以评估其临床相关性。定量和定性分析进一步证明了我们的TransXplainRRG框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。
